title: Modular and On-demand Bias Mitigation with Attribute-Removal Subnetworks

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring attribute leakage by training an adversarial probe (attacker network) on the model's frozen encoding vectors to predict the subject's or author's gender.
Measuring attribute leakage by training an adversarial probe on the model's frozen encoding vectors to predict dialect-based racial identity (African American vs. White American).
Measuring attribute leakage by training an adversarial probe on the model's frozen encoding vectors to predict the author's age group.
